title: Rosemary Beach "Firefly" 45 N. Green Turtle Lane Carriage House
h1: Rosemary Beach "Firefly" 45 N. Green Turtle Lane Carriage House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Premium location – close to beach and town center - South of 30A - Newly Renovated, professionally decorated, new appliances, furnishings and floors. - Two-minute walk to Paradis, Cowgirl Kitchen, and Sugar Shack - 2 Adult bikes- 2 parking spots- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Suitable for 4 guests, Firefly Carriage House has a full kitchen, one queen bed, a single twin bed, and a pullout queen sleeper sofa. The carriage house is newly renovated in October 2022, including new stainless steel kitchen appliances, a newly renovated bathroom featuring Carrara Marble, Waterworks hardware, and cypress wood features. Other features include a 55” Samsung TV, an expansive balcony overlooking Green Turtle Lane, and Wi-Fi.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 4)CARRIAGE HOUSE: Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and Twin Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyAdditional Living Space: Queen Sleeper SofaNote: The carriage house does not have access to a grill.
